Name: na - HD Portraits 2.0 for Sword and Sorcery ES
Author: nimosarts
Description:
[left][b]Sword and Sorcery - A Fantasy Expansion for East Scarp - HD Portraits 2.0

[/b]
[u][b]This Mod includes:
[/b][/u]
[b]Hector[/b] - complete [i]NEW SET[/i] + Book/Wolf
[b]Mateo[/b] - complete [i]NEW SET[/i] + Emeritus/BabyEmeritus/Watts/YoungMateo/Emblem/Krobus ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34158]Krobus HD[/url])
[b]Cirrus[/b] - complete [i]NEW SET[/i] (toggle Make Up Setting: OFF) + Meadowlark

[b]Roslin[/b] - Hair update + Solomon incl.
[b]Dandelion[/b] - Hair update

[i]Mermaid Pendants Overlay for all.[/i]
﻿
[u]

[b]Install:[/b][/u]
Simply put the CP Folders into your Mods folder. 
Make sure to install [u]required[/u] mods.




[u][b]Issues:[/b][/u]
If any issues appear and something is not working as intented, let me know, with specifics, so I can see what I can do.

[u][b]Troubleshoot to me like this please:[/b][/u]
Is it happening during an event? Yes: which one?
do a "[b]patch summary McJoan.[Name][/b]" and send me the SMAPI log via parser. [i]https://smapi.io/log
[/i]for example if u have trouble with Hector u put "[b]patch summary McJoan.Hector[/b]" in your smapi console. with this information I can find the wrong scaled portrait way easier and replicate the problem to fix.


If u have this in your smapi console: 

[b]ERRORContent PatcherPatch error: HD Mateo > Load Portraits/Armor_Mateo has a FromFile which matches non-existent file 'assets\HDPortraits\Mateo\'.
ERRORContent PatcherPatch error: HD Mateo > Load Portraits/MateoMine has a FromFile which matches non-existent file 'assets\HDPortraits\Mateo\'
[/b]
this is normal, and due to dynamic tokens, that will load as soon as Mateo is loaded (so u get this error bc Mateo and the token does not exist at this point - mostly loading screen)

Works with portraiture, but is not needed for it to work. (if u use portraiture, just set to vanilla/HDP)) [/left]
